description: This file defines a React functional component 'ActivityLogContactCreated' which displays an activity log entry for when a contact is created. It utilizes Material UI components and react-admin components to render UI elements, references other components like Avatar, SaleName, and RelativeDate, and consumes context from useActivityLogContext.

methods.name: ActivityLogContactCreated
methods.description: React functional component that displays an activity log item indicating a contact was created, including contact details, link to contact view, and relative date.
